name: Neu-Isenburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 3:7:3, charged at the centre with the city arms of Neu-Isenburg (red and white bars with a black chief).
history: The banner is red-white-red striped lengthwise in the proportions 3:7:3 with the arms above the centre; the hoisted flag follows the same design.

features.role: Neu-Isenburg arms — red and white bars
